question: Which queries in this intake corpus did anybody actually type?
answer: None that this repo can show. Every row in the intake corpus is a template expansion or a hardcoded seed string. No retained artifact - no URL, thread id, SERP capture or Search Console row - backs any query in it.
truth_boundary: This audit says where a string came from. It says nothing about whether the string is a good page target; a generated query can still be a sensible one to write about. What it may not be is counted as demand.
observed_definition: A row is OBSERVED only when a retained artifact shows the string came from outside this repo: a captured URL, a thread or result id, a provider response, or a Search Console row.

observed_artifact_required_per_source.reddit: a thread URL or post id per query, retained
observed_artifact_required_per_source.youtube: a video id or search response, retained
observed_artifact_required_per_source.tiktok: a post id or search response, retained
observed_artifact_required_per_source.x_twitter: a post id or search response, retained
observed_artifact_required_per_source.google_paa: a SERP capture containing the People-Also-Ask block, retained
observed_artifact_required_per_source.competitor_pages: the competitor URL the query was extracted from, retained
observed_artifact_required_per_source.llm_citation_checks: a probe observation with cited URLs, retained
observed_artifact_required_per_source.authority_scale_max_fanout: not applicable - fanout is synthetic by definition
observed_artifact_required_per_source.existing_repo: the repo route the string was read from

data/intake/query_universe.json.generator: scripts/intake/build_query_universe.js - 4-deep cartesian loop over product_role x audience x use_case x source_type, filled into one of 10 string templates

data/intake/query_corpus.json.generator: scripts/intake/collect_queries.js - the universe above plus data/intake/source_ingestion/*

data/intake/source_ingestion/reddit.json.generator: scripts/intake/adapters/reddit.js - a hardcoded 5-element string array; no network call, no retained thread

data/intake/source_ingestion/serp.json.generator: scripts/intake/adapters/serp.js - a hardcoded 5-element string array; no network call, no retained SERP

search_console.note: Search Console returns no rows for any target. It cannot be a discovery source for this repo until the properties accumulate impressions.

what_was_not_done: No query in this corpus was scored by openness or lead intent, and no probe budget was spent on it. Scoring a generated corpus produces a ranked generated corpus - more convincing, no more true.
what_would_close_the_gap: A real collector for any one enabled source in config/source_expansion_policy.json that retains the artifact it read the query from.
Search Console impressions on either property, which arrive on their own once pages are indexed and would be observed by definition.
